rows:
To select how much byte/data have to be captured within a line. This feature is available 
only for a parallel interface camera module.
Allows the user to chose if the filtering starts from the odd or the even byte.
Possibility to filter out one line out of two.
The software can select if the filtering rejects the odd or even lines.
